keyword.sql: SELECT id, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY ts_rank_cd(to_tsvector('english', content), plainto_tsquery('english', :qtext)) DESC, id ASC) AS rank FROM memories WHERE workspace_id IS NULL AND created_by_id = :user_id AND to_tsvector('english', content) @@ plainto_tsquery('english', :qtext) ORDER BY ts_rank_cd(to_tsvector('english', content), plainto_tsquery('english', :qtext)) DESC, id ASC LIMIT :limit

SELECT id, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY ts_rank_cd(to_tsvector('english', content), plainto_tsquery('english', :qtext)) DESC, id ASC) AS rank FROM memories WHERE workspace_id = :workspace_id AND to_tsvector('english', content) @@ plainto_tsquery('english', :qtext) ORDER BY ts_rank_cd(to_tsvector('english', content), plainto_tsquery('english', :qtext)) DESC, id ASC LIMIT :limit

SELECT id, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY ts_rank_cd(to_tsvector('english', content), plainto_tsquery('english', :qtext)) DESC, id ASC) AS rank FROM memories WHERE workspace_id = :workspace_id AND to_tsvector('english', content) @@ plainto_tsquery('english', :qtext) ORDER BY ts_rank_cd(to_tsvector('english', content), plainto_tsquery('english', :qtext)) DESC, id ASC LIMIT :limit

thread-recency-large.sql: SELECT id FROM memories WHERE workspace_id = :ws_id AND research_thread_id = :thread_id ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT :limit
